mapper.select: SELECT p.post_id, p.board_type_code, p.title, p.notice_gubun_code, COALESCE(p.contents_html, p.contents, '') AS contents, p.contents_html, p.contents_json, p.contents_text, p.writer_id, p.writer_name, p.last_modified_by, p.last_modified_by_name, p.view_count, p.is_notice, p.is_deleted, p.created_at, p.updated_at, COALESCE(( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_board_file bf WHERE bf.post_id = p.post_id AND bf.deleted_yn = 'N' ), 0) AS attachment_count FROM tb_board_post p WHERE p.post_id = #{postId} AND p.is_deleted = 'N'

INSERT INTO tb_board_post ( board_type_code, title, notice_gubun_code, contents, contents_html, contents_json, contents_text, writer_id, writer_name, last_modified_by, last_modified_by_name, view_count, is_notice, is_deleted, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{boardTypeCode}, #{title}, #{noticeGubunCode}, #{contents}, #{contentsHtml}, CAST(#{contentsJson} AS json), #{contentsText}, #{writerId}, #{writerName}, #{lastModifiedBy}, #{lastModifiedByName}, 0, #{isNotice}, 'N', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ) RETURNING post_id
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_board_post SET title = #{title}, notice_gubun_code = #{noticeGubunCode}, contents = #{contents}, contents_html = #{contentsHtml}, contents_json = CAST(#{contentsJson} AS json), contents_text = #{contentsText}, writer_name = #{writerName}, last_modified_by = #{lastModifiedBy}, last_modified_by_name = #{lastModifiedByName}, is_notice = #{isNotice}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE post_id = #{postId} AND is_deleted = 'N'
UPDATE tb_board_post SET is_deleted = 'Y', last_modified_by = #{lastModifiedBy}, last_modified_by_name = #{lastModifiedByName}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE post_id = #{postId}
mapper.select: SELECT bf.board_file_id, bf.post_id, bf.file_name, bf.file_path, bf.object_key, bf.bucket_name, bf.storage_provider, bf.file_size, bf.mime_type, bf.checksum_sha256, bf.content_type, bf.file_usage_type, bf.deleted_yn, bf.uploaded_by, bf.created_at, bf.updated_at FROM tb_board_file bf WHERE bf.post_id = #{postId} AND bf.deleted_yn = 'N' ORDER BY bf.created_at DESC

SELECT bf.board_file_id, bf.post_id, bf.file_name, bf.file_path, bf.object_key, bf.bucket_name, bf.storage_provider, bf.file_size, bf.mime_type, bf.checksum_sha256, bf.content_type, bf.file_usage_type, bf.deleted_yn, bf.uploaded_by, bf.created_at, bf.updated_at FROM tb_board_file bf WHERE bf.board_file_id = #{boardFileId} AND bf.deleted_yn = 'N'

INSERT INTO tb_board_file ( post_id, file_name, file_path, object_key, bucket_name, storage_provider, file_size, mime_type, checksum_sha256, content_type, file_usage_type, deleted_yn, uploaded_by, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{postId}, #{fileName}, #{filePath}, #{objectKey}, #{bucketName}, #{storageProvider}, #{fileSize}, #{mimeType}, #{checksumSha256}, #{contentType}, #{fileUsageType}, #{deletedYn}, #{uploadedBy}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ) RETURNING board_file_id
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_board_file SET deleted_yn = 'Y', updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE board_file_id = #{boardFileId}
UPDATE tb_board_file SET deleted_yn = 'Y', updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE post_id = #{postId} AND file_usage_type = 'EMBEDDED' AND deleted_yn = 'N'
